scope.research_boundary: Reuse the same user-authorized Luna Max evidence-only agent; root remains the sole writer. For each exact candidate, inspect its record, linked sources, field attempts, and registered campaign history before one distinct current web query. Open at most one genuinely new product/technical page per candidate. Before opening, literal-search the final URL across data/ and docs/; skip if present or if absence is uncertain. Stop after these ten targets; do not reopen a known URL or retry a failed page.
field_rules: Complete-bike weight must match the retained exact build and preserve size, included equipment/accessories, approximation, and weighing basis. Do not transfer frame weight, sibling trim values, or unqualified review-bike weights.
Drivetrain claims need exact series, speed, layout, actuation, and selected build; do not infer the listing configuration from a family menu.
Tire clearance requires an explicit exact-model maximum; fitted tire width and recommended tire width are not maximum clearance.

Frame stiffness requires an exact-model numeric result or sufficiently specific independent assessment. Mark subjective or build-specific impressions clearly and preserve numeric/protocol limitations.
PARDUS Spark Tourist PES and Spark Sport PES are separate builds; PARDUS Robin Sport PES is not the Spark family.
Keep the two SUNPEED retained options distinct and do not transfer clearance between model families.
Keep all facts tied to the exact retained model and date; preserve unknowns and conflicts.
excluded: No agent edits; no XHS/Weibo, personal browser, login/CAPTCHA, seller outreach, external messages, quote submission, cart, checkout, or purchase.

No image changes, prices, or unrelated specifications. Only frozen fields, directly supporting sources/attempts, coverage baseline if required, attempt-count test expectation if stale, and dated batch documentation may change.
No commit, push, PR, merge, publish, or production change.
